summary.text: Gladys Robinson is a Democratic state senator from North Carolina who represents District 28, covering Guilford County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has served in the Senate since 2011 and is the only candidate listed for the seat on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Robinson earned a bachelor's degree from Bennett College for Women and a Ph.D. from North Carolina A&T State University, according to Ballotpedia.
Robinson assumed office in the Senate on January 1, 2011, according to Ballotpedia.

The General Assembly's website shows her committee assignments in Appropriations on Health and Human Services, Appropriations/Base Budget, Education/Higher Education, Elections, Pensions and Retirement and Aging, and State and Local Government, among others.
The Democratic primary for her seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
